Samir — thanks for the clear recap and for sending this over. Follow-up and answers below; attaching a short SOC 2 status summary and our standard vendor questionnaire starter (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_ACME.xlsx) to speed things up.

SOC 2 status:
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2026; report available under NDA. We run continuous controls monitoring and plan our next annual audit for Q4 2027.

Audit logging capabilities (high-level):
- Admin activity logs: detailed records for console actions (user admin, role changes, config updates). Fields include actor, timestamp, IP, action, target resource, and pre/post metadata when applicable. Retention configurable per-customer policy.
- API request logs: per-request traces with request id, model, latency, request/response size metrics, and caller identity. Includes tokenized metadata and error codes; we do not store full user-provided PII in logs unless customer enables request logging.
- Exportability: logs are exportable to customer S3 buckets (prefixed), and we support streaming to SIEMs via syslog/Kafka connectors. We can provide daily and hourly export configs.
- Immutability & tamper-evidence: audit logs are written to an append-only store with checksums, and exports include SHA256 manifests. For higher assurance, we support write-once object storage export (S3 WORM when configured on the bucket side) and can provide signed manifests for long-term retention.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Status_Summary.pdf (high-level), Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_ACME.xlsx (questionnaire start).

Next steps / suggested plan:
1) Please send the completed questionnaire; Neha (cc'd) will triage and own the technical responses.
2) Schedule the 60-min deep-dive: Neha/Aditya can lead infra/serving runtime + logging export walkthrough. We have availability Wed 3/24 1:00-3:00pm PT or Thu 3/25 10:00-12:00pm PT — what works best?
3) If you need a copy of the full SOC 2 report, we can share under NDA — we can start the NDA and DocuSign flow once you're ready.

Action items assigned: 
- Neha: prepare logging export examples and SIEM connector docs (action owner: neha_kapoor)
- Aditya: prepare quick demo of admin audit trail and console logs (action owner: aditya_rao)
- Marissa: coordinate NDA / SOC 2 report access and follow up on procurement/contract questions (action owner: marissa_cole)

Let me know which deep-dive slot you prefer and we'll lock it.

Best,
